documents.instruction: Keep the three-part mental model true to src/: selection boundary, one Brama call, sync memory.
One happy path from clone to a reconciled document; every command and flag must exist in src/cli.ts, and captured console output must never be fabricated — only replaced with freshly captured output.
Complete command, flag, default, output-shape, and exit-code reference for src/cli.ts.
The sync state machine exactly as src/sync.ts implements it: manifest, state, baseline before generation, passing audit is the update.
Selection, exclusion, ordering, budget, and confinement rules exactly as src/sources.ts implements them.
Environment variables, the Brama request contract, and budgets as src/cli.ts and src/brama.ts read them; never include credential values.
Every documented export must exist in src/index.ts.
The docs-cli pipeline stages, validators, endpoint resolution, and exit codes as pipeline/src implements them.
What Kronika owns, what it does not, data flow, and trust boundaries; every boundary claim must be traceable to src/ or pipeline/src.
Every error sentence in src/ (and the docs-cli exit codes), quoted exactly, with meaning and fix; remove sentences that leave the source, add ones that enter it.
The SourceCollection noun: shape, lifecycle, invariants, and exact refusal sentences from src/sources.ts.
The audit noun: exact range resolution, verdict contract, and refusal sentences as src/checker.ts implements them.

The check noun: the gate verb over one audit — required --base, three-dot range, unrestricted diff scope, output shapes, the never-fails-open exit contract, and the exact refusal sentences; captured console output must never be fabricated.
The finding noun: field-by-field shape and validation sentences, and the rewrite brief format blockers are compiled into.
The severity axis: the system-prompt standard, what blockers and warnings each do in check and sync, and the two mechanical enforcement sentences; captured console output must never be fabricated.
The sync manifest noun: schema, per-entry fields and overrides, lifecycle, and the exact loadSyncManifest refusal sentences.
The sync state noun: entry shape, when the file is written and committed, recovery by deletion, and the exact loadSyncState refusal sentences.
The baseline noun: the action table, baseline-before-generation, advancing without churn, failure keeping the range; captured console output must never be fabricated.
The drift noun: the exact git diff question, pathspec restriction including the output itself, and why drift is not a verdict.

A gating walkthrough whose transcripts were captured by actually running the CLI; update commands and sentences to match src/, but never fabricate console output — stale captures must be re-captured, not invented.

A full sync-cycle walkthrough whose transcripts were captured by actually running the CLI; update commands and sentences to match src/, but never fabricate console output — stale captures must be re-captured, not invented.
Index of the runnable example scripts; every command and flag named must exist in src/cli.ts and every listed script must exist in docs/examples/.
